title: 🏢 Samsung appoints a new head of phones after seven years!
body: 🏢 Samsung appoints a new head of phones after seven years!
Samsung has announced leadership changes, appointing Won-Jun Choi as the new head of the 'MX' phone experience division, succeeding TM Roh, who led the division for about seven years.

Choi had been the division's chief operating officer since March 2025, and led the launch of the 'Galaxy S26' and 'Galaxy Z Fold 8' series. Roh remains a co-CEO of the company and head of the broader device experience division. The changes also included appointing Sang-Jun Hwang as head of the memory sector, Sang-Yoon Cho as head of the semiconductor systems sector, and Jung-Myung Lee as chief technology officer of the device solutions division.
These changes come as part of the company's plan for the next phase, with a special focus on boosting the competitiveness of the semiconductor business in the AI era.
Simply put: imagine a football team changing its captain after seven years; the faces at the top change, but the players and the plan keep playing.
